items.q: What catastrophe did Gates say was more likely than war to kill 10 million?
items.a: A **highly infectious virus**. Nuclear risk got basement barrels and a deterrent budget. Epidemic risk got almost no **stop system**.

items.q: What was wrong with the Ebola response?
items.a: Not a bad system — **no system**. Paper case reports, no ready epidemiologists or medical team. WHO funded to **monitor**, not to surge.

items.q: What did Gates want copied from NATO / the military?
items.a: Full-time staff, **reserves**, rapid deploy, military lift and security, plus **germ games**. Last US germ game he cited: **2001**. Score: germs 1, people 0.

items.q: Why did Ebola stay mostly in three countries?
items.a: Heroic workers + not airborne + contagious when **bedridden** + few cities. That last part was **luck**.
**No panic.** Use Ebola as an early warning and start building the system. Time is not on our side.
